lines: Decision needed from Brandon, unchanged, one thing only he can do: the automation that restarts this build ends Friday noon Mountain Time and a run may not move its own end. He can move the end to Sunday noon in the automation's settings, or write any line in the thread. The Partner raises it again Friday morning. Open item 252.

Chain 17 is read whole and on origin main (`a7f9032b`, pushed 05:50 UTC): the page's carried state alone. On it: tsc exit 0, build exit 0, engine `e9974387113d89df`; M4 0.9694, 0.9106, 0.9546, 0.9607 and M5 0.9929, 1, 0.9686, 0.9997, all pass and the same as chain 16; 0 of the eight draft stills changed; the whole vitest 67 files passed and 1 skipped, 925 tests passed and 4 skipped; `node tools/miniatures.mjs` pass; triangles at high unchanged. With it a frame drawn after the thirty before it is the same bytes as the frame drawn fresh, so the masters can be drawn in chunks on any machine.

Picture 1 is the shutter for the 4K masters, film frame 1337 at 3840, a small light at four times: the old way left, the earlier mend in the middle, the new deal right. The reading sent at 05:19 held when its builder measured it: the lens points repeated along the travel every 12.8 samples, which drew a small light as a wavy line. The new deal orders the same lens points so their mean under the spread's weights lies still. By its builder's measures (STATED, pictures looked at here) the slow unevenness the earlier mend could not touch falls on the small light from 3.91 to 2.36 and on the grey things in the glass from 1.02 to 0.78. Here the light is a straight bar and the grey things are smooth blocks with a striation found only at four times. That passes my look for this one frame and is not yet a pass for 4K motion. It is pushed as `agent/p6-shutter` `e53ce501` with its byte proofs at 1920 (STATED); the master chunk 712 to 715 is being drawn twice at 3840, then one of the fastest frames the old way and the new. It is merged after that is read and looked at. Decision 182.
Three pushes were looked at and held, each for one more short list, because each gains in one place and loses in another. Nothing below is on main.

Picture 2 is fall's base: the approved picture above, main in the middle, the fourth list below. Gained: the right flank is no longer bare, the left pumpkin has lost its purple. Lost: at full 4K size the vines read as flat ribbons with long pale streaks, like brushed brass, where the approved has dark rough twigs with small wet glints (bright runs along the row 6.1 px against 3.2 px in its builder's own pair, the levels equal). Its builder said itself that its detail number's last step, 0.747 to 0.823 on its machine, came from that light and not from form. The fifth list: the light off relief in short dashes, the right flank's sheen a thin broken line, the web thinner and dimmer. Push by 06:40 UTC.

Picture 3 is spring's base: the approved picture above, main in the middle, the fourth list below. Gained: the stones are small, rounded and mossed in the joints, and the body's tone sits on the approved's (17, 20, 15 against 17, 20, 16). Lost: the rim is a pale straw ring where the approved's is dark green at the left and middle (54, 54, 33 against 27, 34, 22), the outline is larger than the approved's and than main's (front height 310 px against 245), the thin roots at the right read as a comb of pale strands. The fifth list: the rim green with straw only where the sun strikes, the edge made uneven by dips and not by raised cushions, three or four thick roots in place of eight thin ones, the water. Push by 06:50 UTC.

Picture 4 is summer's tree: the approved picture left, main in the middle, the eighth pass right. The eighth parts the crown into masses with sky between, which the approved has and main does not, but the masses are flat tiers with level undersides and wide square bands, so it reads lighter and more tiered than the approved's round pads. Its builder reads it the same way. The ninth pass is form only: each pad a dome, the bands narrowed to slits (1.6 mm against 3.7), the fork closed to three or four holes. A first picture by 06:40 UTC, push by 07:20.

The change of season: its finisher's push of all four shakes has slipped to about 07:15 UTC. It measured that the hand over of the shared storm to summer's own makes the glass fall by up to 9.7 levels a frame over film frames 1407 to 1412, against the bar of 6. That is in summer's air and went to its builder at 05:41 with a push due 06:45.

Chain 18 runs here since 05:58 UTC on two merges, neither on origin yet. Summer's sand third push (`agent/p6-summer-sand` `e7698d48`), looked at first: the mound at the base's right foot is broader and its shade is soft where main's was a small crisp wedge; still below the bar, smaller and flatter than the approved's, and it does not come round the front of the base. Summer's base sixth list (`agent/p6-summer-stone` `c9258402`), merged ahead of its builder's full report so one chain checks both; the chain's own review still of summer at rest is looked at beside the approved picture before anything is pushed, and the merge is reverted if that look fails. Summer's cottage is not in it: its builder found at 05:35 that its own wall measure had used too small a mask, and by the true one the gable reads 19 and 23 levels too light and orange; it mends that first and reports about 07:00 UTC. Then round 22, four fresh critics on summer, as soon as chain 18 is on main.

Render counts since the last status. Drawn here: chain 17's change measure and eight draft stills; chain 18's are running. On helper machines: the builders' own stills and frames, one more 3840 frame of 1337 by the shutter's builder and its chunk of four running. No frame of the masters yet.
Sound: 7,420 of 10,000 credits, unchanged, no call planned.
phase 6: 27.15 h used of its 12.00 h box
